{{Quote|For those of you who just arrived, I will explain this only once. Although in truth, I shouldn't have to explain it at all. Your own Force sensitivity ought to be sufficient for you to realize that we're dealing with an unforeseen development at the academy&mdash;a chain of events that, at this point, is still unclear.|Master Traan, to a convocation of Sith students|<ref name="Red Harvest" />}}
'''Traan''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as a [[Sith Master/Legends|Master]] in the [[Sith/Legends|Sith Order]] under the banner of the reconstituted [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. In [[3645 BBY]], Traan was serving as an instructor at the [[Odacer-Faustin Sith academy|Sith academy]] on the frozen [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Odacer-Faustin]] under the direction of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Scabrous]]. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], one of [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] Scabrous's [[Sith alchemy/Legends|alchemical]] experiments resulted in the creation of a [[Imperial bioweapons Project I71A|virus]] that [[Death/Legends|killed]] living flesh and [[Zombie/Legends|reanimated]] the deceased. When an [[Wim Nickter|infected student]] escaped [[Darth Scabrous's tower|Scabrous's tower]] and began to spread the disease, Traan and the [[Sith academy|academy's]] other Masters sensed a [[Disturbance in the Force/Legends|disturbance in the Force]] and decided to suspend normal instruction until the issue passed. Traan informed the students of the choice during a short convocation, but the decision ultimately did little good&mdash;the disease quickly claimed the lives of the entirety of the student body as well as those of the academy's leaders.

==Biography==
{{Quote|As a precaution, we are suspending all lessons and drills until further notice. Evening meal will be served as usual. Otherwise you are to return to your dorms for private study and await further instructions. One of the Masters will be in contact when our course of action changes.|Traan, outlining the plan of action during the crisis|<ref name="Red Harvest" />}}
Traan was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="Red Harvest" /> alive during the [[Great Galactic War]] and the resultant [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|period of political unrest]].<ref name="Wars">{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Timeline 1: Treaty of Coruscant|int=Timeline 1: Treaty of Coruscant}} establishes that the [[Great Galactic War]] came to a close in [[3653 BBY]], while ''[[The Old Republic: Fatal Alliance]]'' states that the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] that followed lasted at least ten years. [[Red Harvest (novel)|''Red Harvest'']] takes place eight years after the Great War, indicating that the events of the novel occur during the Cold War.</ref> During this [[Time/Legends|time]], he was a member of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith Order]] and eventually rose to become a [[Sith Master/Legends|Master]] of the Sith ways.<ref name="Red Harvest" /> The Great War between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] came to a [[Treaty of Coruscant|close]] in [[3653 BBY]],<ref name="Timeline 1">{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Timeline 1: Treaty of Coruscant|int=Timeline 1: Treaty of Coruscant}}</ref> at which point the Imperial leadership chose to not only maintain their output of [[Sith Warrior|Sith warriors]] and leaders, but to increase it.<ref name="FA">''[[The Old Republic: Fatal Alliance]]''</ref> In the first decade following the war, Traan served as instructor at the [[Odacer-Faustin Sith academy|Sith academy]] on the chilly [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Odacer-Faustin]], where he [[Sith training|cultivated]] new generations of [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] [[Sith acolyte/Legends|adepts]]. Alongside his contemporaries, including [[Sith Blademaster]] [[Shak'Weth]] and [[Combat Master|Sith Combat Master]] [[Xat Hracken]], Traan's lessons were overseen by the reclusive [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Scabrous]].<ref name="Red Harvest" />

In [[3645 BBY]], Scabrous was experimenting with [[Sith alchemy/Legends|Sith alchemy]] in an effort to create an immortality-granting elixir. The Sith [[Lord/Legends|Lord's]] plan backfired and ultimately resulted in a [[Imperial bioweapons Project I71A|virus]] that caused necrosis in living flesh and [[Zombie/Legends|reanimated]] the corpses of the [[Death/Legends|deceased]]. When a [[Wim Nickter|student]] carrying the disease escaped [[Darth Scabrous's tower]] and began to spread the infection, the academy's staff and student body experienced a [[Disturbance in the Force/Legends|disturbance in the Force]]. The Masters collectively decided that the unknown events causing the disturbance were a significant threat, and so chose to suspend normal instructional activities for the duration of the problem. Traan led a group of his students to a convocation that consisted of nearly all of the academy's acolytes, wherein he addressed the learners on the issue at hand. During his speech, he speculated that the academy may have fallen victim to some form of sabotage centered around Scabrous's tower, but regardless of the source of the disturbance, all students were to return to their dormitories until further notice. Despite the precautions of Odacer-Faustin's Sith Masters, the disease continued to spread throughout the student body, and eventually claimed the lives of the staff as well.<ref name="Red Harvest" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Most of you have already detected a disturbance in the normal daily routine. At this point, we suspect that the academy has been targeted by some form of sabotage, and that it may have spread outward from the tower.|Traan explains the situation to his students|<ref name="Red Harvest" />)}}
Traan was a Sith Master, skilled in the darker aspects of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. By 3645 BBY, he had [[Color/Legends|gray]] hair that he wore in a single braid, and he was considered to be an older man by [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] fugitive [[Hestizo Trace]]. Traan's face was angular and [[Hawk/Legends|hawk]]-like in structure, and his [[Sith apparel|robes]] gave his silhouette the appearance of having wings. Traan spoke in sharp, flinty tones that projected easily and commanded attention from his pupils, who numbered in the hundreds.<ref name="Red Harvest" />

During the convocation called to inform the students on Odacer-Faustin of the apparent threat, Traan spoke to the entirety of the student body. The Sith Master spoke harshly, demanding silence and insinuating that it should be a pointless exercise to inform the acolytes of what they ought to already be aware, given their Force-sensitivity and training. He and the other Masters believed that the crisis was the result of outside tampering, but Trace detected uncertainty in his voice. Despite Traan's best efforts to mask his doubts, the Jedi Trace was able to see that he had no real understanding of the events at hand and certainly no control over them.<ref name="Red Harvest" />

==Behind the scenes==
Traan appeared in the [[2010]] novel [[Red Harvest (novel)|''Red Harvest'']], which was written by [[Joe Schreiber]].<ref name="Red Harvest" />
